title: AgentCalibrationParams
description: Params of the agent.calibration request: the read half of the guided calibration (nocx-etejh). Verifying a rule against a recording it happened to be pointed at proves nothing — a rule that never matches looks exactly like a rule that works — so the person produces the evidence: nocx asks them to drive their agent into a named state and labels the frame with the state it asked for. This request only LOOKS, and it is a pull rather than a subscription for the same reason agent.emitting is: the request is the looking, so a surface that has closed asks nothing.

sessionId.description: The enrolled pane whose agent is being calibrated, by its server-authoritative session id (AD-7). OPTIONAL: without it the answer carries only the list of panes nocx is watching, which is what a surface asks for before a person has picked one. Naming a pane that is no longer watched is not an error — the answer simply carries no calibration.
